text: ……　……　……　ポケモンを　つよく　そだてて　たたかう　ポケモン　トレーナー！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つよく　そだてて
ポケモン　トレーナー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そだてて　たたかう　ポケモン　トレーナー
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb sits before a thing and tells you what kind it is. そだてて　たたかう　ポケモン　トレーナー = 'Pokémon Trainers who raise them and battle'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. そだてて = 'raise them and'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く lets a describing word tell how an action is done or what it leads to. つよく　そだてて = 'raise them to be strong'.
